propositions: The ticket-type map is duplicated in two locations (Cloud and DC adapters) with no shared source, mirroring a closed defect class (fe15) where duplicate maps drifted silently
Both copies are content-identical (four keys, same values, differing only in literal key order) and must be unified under a single canonical definition in adapters/jira_family/value_maps.py

Consumers of the ticket-type map must import it under the historical private alias _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE to preserve module-attribute resolution for the existing test in test_outbound_differ_session_log_exclusion.py
A boundary guard test must be added to enforce exactly one dict literal under adapters/, mirroring the existing guards for status and priority maps and preventing future duplication
The unification is behavior-preserving on both deployments and requires no divergence decision, but the guard must be mutation-tested by reintroducing a literal and confirming test failure
